name: facebookresearch_pyrobot/robots/LoCoBot/locobot_control/scripts/locobot_control/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_pyrobot/robots/LoCoBot/.test_check_safety: test the RobotTeleoperationServer check_safety method for collision avoidance heuristics
